mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and UGT1A1, significantly increasing zidovudine glucuronidation and clearance, reducing zidovudine plasma concentrations and antiviral efficacy.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor zidovudine levels closely with dose adjustment; consider alternative antiretroviral agents with rifampin-sparing regimens when treating tuberculosis co-infection.
